content:
Ellen: tiny idea  "Model Open-Mic / Roast" at lunch? teams bring 2 jokes, 1 wholesome compliment. no infra host names used as punchlines pls :laughing:
Ravi: yes. rules: keep it PG, no real outages, and the models get a safe word: "softmax". :thumbsup:
Mateo: sample roast line: "Falcon is like a cat that knows all your secrets and still ignores you." :cat: 
Claire: and Llama2 roast: "Llama2 brings spreadsheets to a party and color-codes the snacks." :spiral_note_pad:
Ellen: micro-challenge: submit your best model pickup line. winner gets a sticker + bagel. entries are 1-liners only.
Ravi: mine: "Are you a tokenizer? Because you make my heart split into meaningful pieces." :heartpulse:
Mateo: entry: "You must be a cached prefix, because I keep coming back to you." :revolving_hearts:
Claire: safety quip: "Hey Vicuna, are you fine-tuned? Because my prompts get better around you." :sparkles:
stickerbot: new sticker suggestion posted: "I survived the Model Roast" with a small raccoon in sunglasses. React :heart: to upvote.
Ellen: also quick improv prompt idea (for the winners):
```
You are a stand-up comedian model. Give a 2-line roast about a coworker who always debugs at 2am. Keep it light and witty.
```
Ravi: someone suggested a slot called "Compliments and Backhands" where each roast must be followed by a sincere compliment. love that. :clap:
Mateo: can we have a buzzer sound when a line is too spicy? I nominate "softmax" as the curb.
Claire: @lunchbot can we reserve the small kitchen and order bagels + coffee? winners need celebratory pastries.
lunchbot: Heads up  "Model Open-Mic Roast" scheduled for Friday 12:30-13:15. Catering: bagels + coffee. Budget owner: @PeopleOps.
Ellen: final voting for pickup-line contest (informal): Ravi 12 votes, Mateo 9 votes, Claire 4 votes. Ravi wins the sticker + bagel.
Ravi: acceptance speech: "Thanks, I'll be accepting stickers and token payments. Also I'll be around to debug prompts at 3pm." :microphone:
Mateo: idea: tiny merch: enamel pin line that says "I made a model blush". low-cost, high-embarrassment.
Claire: also reminder: memes welcome but avoid actual hostnames/hard-to-explain infra jokes. my 2am brain cannot handle mythic raccoons in the logs. :sleeping:
stickerbot: Uploaded draft sticker art to #design: link: https://imgur.com/mock-sticker-roast (mockup).
Ellen: thanks team. see you Friday. bring cleverness and, if possible, non-toxic roast energy. :raised_hands:
